title: Recent development of active metallic nanostructures-encapsulated carbon hybrid materials for ORR, OER, and HER applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19802-19825
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00427J, Review Article

This review provides insight into the research progress in transition metal@carbon (TM@C) hybrids, focusing on their systematic synthesis approach, structure–electrochemical properties relationships, and prospective electrochemical applications.
